input: Find a flatmate to split rent costs

gold.taskTitle: Find a Flatmate to Split Rent Costs
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find a suitable flatmate to share their living space and split rental expenses.

questions.title: What city and neighbourhood is the flat located in?
questions.description: Understanding the location helps tailor where and how to advertise for a flatmate.

questions.title: What is the total monthly rent and your share?
questions.description: Knowing the rent split amount helps frame the listing accurately and attract the right candidates.

questions.title: When do you need the flatmate to move in?
questions.description: The move-in date determines the urgency of the search and deadlines for the plan.

questions.title: Is this a spare room in your current home?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the user is already living in the flat or both parties would be moving in fresh.

questions.title: Do you have preferences on gender, age, or lifestyle?
questions.description: Knowing any flatmate preferences ensures the search and screening criteria are correctly defined.

questions.title: Which platforms have you already tried for this search?
questions.description: Avoids duplicating effort on channels the user has already explored and focuses on new options.

questions.title: Are pets, smoking, or couples permitted in the flat?
questions.description: House rules are critical filtering criteria that must be clearly stated in any listing or outreach.
